name: Naru Clinic
description: Naru Clinic is an occupational health WordPress theme designed for workplace health providers, industrial clinics, and ergonomic assessors. Built for clarity and practical patient guidance, it features structured assessment workflows, transparent service pricing, and calm, accessible layouts. Clean typography and responsive block templates ensure workers and managers find essential health information effortlessly.
